game.core.rules.readable.title: Recipes and Downtime
game.core.rules.readable.summary: A crafting recipe declares its inputs and output, while a recorded downtime episode owns progress, completion, and cancellation.

blocks.heading: Use a declared recipe
items: Choose a known recipe and confirm its declared output, materials, tools, and time requirements.
Begin a downtime episode for the selected activity and record progress against that episode.
Complete the episode only when its declared requirements are satisfied, or cancel it without inventing an output.

blocks.heading: Recipe records are references
blocks.body: The registry explains installed recipes. It does not execute crafting or substitute a generic browser formula for catalog mechanics.
